messages:
vivian: FYI CI failed on the sample app publish job. Looks like the release step expected a minor bump but package.json stayed at patch.
build-bot: publish-workflow: failed at semantic-check step — reason: semver-inference mismatch (expected: minor; found: patch)
omar: Any regendiff output?
vivian: Pasted the local regendiff: 
```
- export interface ClientOpts { timeout?: number }
+ export interface ClientOpts { timeout?: number }
+ export interface RetryMetadata { attempts?: number }
```
shane: So type-only RetryMetadata was added by the retry-refactor and typegen picked it up. Our semver rules currently treat any exported type add as minor, but changelog-gen only looks at commit tags. That causes the workflow to think theres a mismatch.
omar: Right. This is similar to previous issues but in the sample-app the sample packager doesn't run typegen before the semver-check step.
aria: Short patch: run `yarn regen` in the sample-app job before semver infer so the regendiff disappears (or is committed). Longer term: either 1) relax type-only semantics to patch, or 2) ensure typegen output is committed as part of the change.
shane: I prefer marking internal types with /** @internal */ so typegen won't export them. Might be the cleanest to avoid accidental API surface changes.
vivian: Implemented a quick hack in CI to skip semver mismatch when diffs only touch `src/types.ts` in sample-apps. I'll push the change as a stopgap.
vivian: CI patch PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-app/pull/495 (adds regen step and a small guard).
build-bot: CI: sample-app/pull/495  checks started.
omar: Action items: omar to open DX ticket to align semver heuristics with regendiff labels; shane to propose @internal policy for type exports; aria to add a short note to the onboarding doc about running regen before PRs.
shane: filing DX ticket: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/DX-980-type-export-policy
aria: I'll update the onboarding doc this afternoon and link PR.
vivian: After the CI patch merged I re-ran the publish job locally and it passed. Will monitor for other sample-apps.
omar: Thanks team, let's track follow-ups in the ticket and close this thread once docs/policy land.
